北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，但体感 -14℃，注意保暖防寒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, but feels like -14℃. Stay warm and bundled up!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 8℃，出门记得添衣，别着凉啦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 8℃. Remember to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 5℃ 偏冷，风大，多穿点哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels chilly at 5℃ with strong winds. Layer up!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，湿度 94%，出门记得带伞，小心潮湿。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy with 94% humidity. Carry an umbrella and beware of dampness.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，湿度 82%，体感 16℃，注意除湿哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with 82% humidity, feels like 16℃. Remember to dehumidify.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 3℃，风力不小，多穿点防风哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 3℃ with brisk winds. Dress warmly and windproof.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 2℃ 有风，出门别忘添衣，暖暖和和。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like 2℃ and windy. Don't forget to layer up for warmth.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%，要注意防潮除湿哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with 100% humidity. Remember to take precautions against dampness.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，体感 6℃，出门注意防护，保重身体。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, feels like 6℃. Take precautions when going out and stay healthy.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安小雨，体感 -1℃，雨天湿冷，注意保暖防滑。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an has light rain, feels like -1℃. It's wet and cold, stay warm and be careful of slippery surfaces.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阵雨，湿度 95%，出门别忘带雨具，小心路滑。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has showers with 95% humidity. Don't forget your umbrella and watch out for slippery roads.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -31℃！极寒，请务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -31℃! Extremely cold, please dress warmly and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -31℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -20℃，寒意十足，多穿衣物保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, but feels like -20℃. It's very cold, wear plenty of layers to stay warm.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴天，体感 3℃，早晚温差大，记得添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 3℃. Big temperature difference, remember to add layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 11℃，风力不小，多穿件外套吧。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 11℃ with brisk winds. Wear an extra jacket.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -8℃，风力 4级，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -8℃ with strong winds. Remember to stay warm and windproof.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -13℃，注意防寒，别感冒了。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -13℃. Take care to keep warm and avoid catching a cold.
